policyname: Read own or internal invoice items
qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM invoices i
  WHERE ((i.id = invoice_items.invoice_id) AND ((i.customer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_internal_user()))))
((customer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_internal_user())

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM invoices
  WHERE ((invoices.id = payments.invoice_id) AND (invoices.customer_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR is_internal_user())
((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_internal_user())
